400.title: "Deepen ties in defence, space, nuclear energy": PM Modi invites Polish firms for co-production
400.summary: Addressing a joint press meet with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk at Hyderabad House in New Delhi, PM Modi said, "Today, we have reached an agreement to deepen relations in defence, space, and nuclear energy.
400.body: Addressing a joint press meet with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk at Hyderabad House in New Delhi, PM Modi said, "Today, we have reached an agreement to deepen relations in defence, space, and nuclear energy. We invite companies from Poland to engage in co-development and co-production with India in all these strategic sectors." Highlighting the importance of cultural and people-to-people exchanges in strengthening bilateral ties, PM Modi said these connections remained the greatest strength of India-Poland relations. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi also said that the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement (FTA) has broadened opportunities for the India-Poland partnership, highlighting India's growing economic strength and the momentum in bilateral relations over the past two years. India and Poland elevated their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership during PM Modi's visit to Poland in August 2024.
